title: Quasi-coherent etale cohomology comparison natural in scheme pullback
statement:
Let $X,Y$ be quasi-compact separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $g:Y\to X$ a scheme morphism, and $F$ and $G$ quasi-coherent modules on $X$ and $Y$ respectively [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F_{\mathrm{et}},G_{\mathrm{et}}$ be their associated additive etale sheaves [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Fix the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]: for schemes in universe $u$, use the common coefficient category $\mathrm{AddCommGrp}_{u+1}$ of the recorded inverse-image and cohomology-pullback functors. Set $L$ to sectionwise $\operatorname{ULift}^{u+1}$, transporting addition and every restriction map. This is the common-lift formulation of the source comparison, rather than quantification over the identity and arbitrary further coefficient-universe lifts. For every $q\ge0$ there are canonical additive isomorphisms
$$c^q_{X,F}:H^q(X_{\mathrm{et}},L(F_{\mathrm{et}}))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(X,F),$$
where the right side is Zariski module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] and the left side is abelian etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. In degree zero $c^0$ is $\operatorname{ULift.down}$ on sections, using the canonical tensor-pullback unit to identify sections on the terminal etale object and the degree-zero right-derived global-sections comparison. These isomorphisms are simultaneous for all such schemes and modules and natural as follows. For every module morphism $\psi:g^*F\to G$ [def-pc-module-pullback], let $\psi_{\mathrm{et}}:g^{-1}L(F_{\mathrm{et}})\to L(G_{\mathrm{et}})$ be adjoint to the sectionwise map sending a section on an etale $U\to X$ to its structural pullback on $U\times_XY$, followed by the pullback of $\psi$. Then
$$c^q_{Y,G}\circ H^q(\psi_{\mathrm{et}})\circ g_{\mathrm{et}}^*=\psi_{\mathrm{Zar}}^*\circ c^q_{X,F},$$
where $g_{\mathrm{et}}^*$ is [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] and $\psi_{\mathrm{Zar}}^*$ is the module cohomology map of the adjoint $F\to g_*G$ [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. In particular, for $g=\mathrm{id}$ and multiplication by $a\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ these comparisons intertwine multiplication by $a$ on both cohomology groups (or by its lift on the left). The lifted associated sheaf and module-morphism action are the constructions recorded in [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]; only those constructions are used here, with no properness or base-field restriction.

proof.text: Choose the uniquely normalized comparison on every scheme and invert each additive equivalence. Cancel the two degree-zero equivalences and apply its explicit section normalization.
Apply normalized pullback compatibility to obtain the coefficient sheaf map, its structural component formula and the cohomology equality.

For scalar multiplication specialize the direct module-cohomology coefficient naturality of the single-scheme comparison to F.smulHom a, evaluate at the inverse image of x, and cancel the chosen additive equivalence.
